findings.scenario: A developer who has ever run `node scripts/build.js` (so gitnexus/dist/cli/index.js exists) edits analyzer/PDG code under src/ and runs `node --import tsx bench/impact-pdg/measure.mjs` (or `--check`/`--mutation`). cliChildArgs now unconditionally prefers dist/cli/index.js whenever the file exists, so the child `analyze --pdg` runs the stale compiled analyzer and the bench reports (and gates baselines/recall against) old behaviour with no warning. Before this diff the main analyze process always ran from src via tsx.
findings.evidence: measure.mjs:129 `return fs.existsSync(DIST_CLI) ? [DIST_CLI, ...rest] : [TSX_CLI, CLI_ENTRY, ...rest];` — existence is the only criterion; no mtime/freshness check, no env override, no log of which entry was used. analyzeAndImpact (measure.mjs:174) is the sole caller (detect_changes: analyzeAndImpact touched). CI is unaffected because the workflow builds dist immediately before running.
findings.recommendation: Make the choice explicit and visible: e.g. select dist only when an env flag (set by the workflow) is present or when dist is newer than src, and print which CLI entry the child uses to stderr.

findings.scenario: The lockfile was regenerated with an npm version that strips the `libc` field, removing glibc/musl constraints from @rolldown/binding-linux-* and lightningcss-linux-* optional entries. On Linux, `npm ci` with this lockfile can no longer filter by libc, so both gnu and musl native bindings are considered for install, and the next contributor using the repo's npm will re-add the fields, causing lockfile churn unrelated to the Babel devDependency addition.
findings.evidence: `git diff package-lock.json` removes `"libc": ["glibc"]` / `["musl"]` from node_modules/@rolldown/binding-linux-{arm64,ppc64,s390x,x64}-{gnu,musl} and node_modules/lightningcss-linux-{arm64,x64}-{gnu,musl}; these removals are unrelated to the four @babel/* additions in package.json.
findings.recommendation: Regenerate package-lock.json with the npm version the repo/CI uses (npm >=10.9 / 11) so the libc fields are preserved and the diff contains only the @babel/* additions.
